title: The locked-reread ownership check in breakStaleLock has both halves unpinned: the only interleaving test replaces the lock differing in pid AND stamp, so a pid-only or stamp-only mutant survives the suite

acceptanceCriteria.text: A case at the afterStaleJudgement seam replaces the judged-stale lock with one differing ONLY in pid, asserts breakStaleLock returns false and leaves that replacement lock on disk, and a mutation of the locked-reread comparison keeping only its STAMP half (dropping the pid check) turns exactly that case red

A second case at the same seam replaces the judged-stale lock with one differing ONLY in stamp, asserts the same refusal, and a mutation keeping only its PID half (dropping the stamp check) turns exactly that case red
The unmutated check leaves the suite green, and both mutation runs with their red counts are recorded in the implementation notes

implementationNotes: QCLI-525 pins both halves of the locked-reread ownership check in breakStaleLock. Two cases at the afterStaleJudgement seam, each replacing the judged-stale lock with one differing in exactly ONE half: PID only (stamp preserved, pid becomes this live process) and STAMP only (the dead pid preserved, stamp renewed). Each asserts breakStaleLock returns false, leaves the replacement lock on disk, and removes its own break file. MUTATION EVIDENCE, measured on test/qcli495-id-allocation-unit.test.ts (23 tests): unmutated 23 pass / 0 fail; comparison keeping only the pid half (stamp check dropped) 22 pass / 1 fail, red is EXACTLY the stamp-only case; comparison keeping only the stamp half (pid check dropped) 22 pass / 1 fail, red is EXACTLY the pid-only case. Source restored and verified byte-identical (sha256 4a2ba6ed). NOTE on AC wording: AC1 pairs the pid-only case with the pid-keeping mutant and AC2 pairs the stamp-only case with the stamp-keeping mutant, but measured, each case is killed by the mutant that keeps the OTHER half. The substance the task intends -- each half individually pinned, each mutant red on exactly one case -- is met and measured; only the AC attribution reads inverted. bun run check exit 0 under bun 1.4.3: typecheck, lint, format, layer, 1303 unit tests, 45 mod tests; local mod arm NOT TYPECHECKED for 2.1.308 (pre-existing).
finalSummary: QCLI-525 closes the coverage gap the QCLI-523 round-2 review found in breakStaleLock locked-reread ownership check. Two cases at the afterStaleJudgement seam each replace the judged-stale lock with one differing in exactly one half -- PID only, and STAMP only -- and assert the breaker refuses and leaves that replacement on disk. Measured on the allocator unit file (23 tests): unmutated 23 pass / 0 fail; a comparison keeping only the pid half turns exactly the stamp-only case red (22/1); a comparison keeping only the stamp half turns exactly the pid-only case red (22/1); the source was restored and verified byte-identical. The AC text pairs each case with the mutant that keeps the same half, but measured each case is killed by the mutant keeping the other half; the task intent -- both halves individually pinned -- is met, and the measurement is recorded rather than the attribution. No production code changed. bun run check exit 0 under bun 1.4.3 (typecheck, lint, format, layer, 1303 unit tests, 45 mod tests; local mod arm NOT TYPECHECKED for 2.1.308, pre-existing).
